description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values for multiple multilingual BERT model variants across language families, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable “family,” with categories ordered left to right as IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and above 30 to accommodate error bars). Each family has six adjacent bars corresponding to the legend entries: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with black error bars. Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (mBERT-L₂ ~2, XLM-L₂ ~1, mBERT-R₂ ~3–4, XLM-R₂ ~3, mBERT-B₂ ~6, XLM-B₂ ~5); IE-Germanic has mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~10, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ near 0 to slightly negative, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~15; IE-Indic shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near 0, mBERT-R₂ around ~20, XLM-R₂ around ~18, mBERT-B₂ around ~24, and XLM-B₂ around ~21; IE-Romance shows mid single-digit values for L₂ and R₂ (roughly ~4–7) with XLM-R₂ near ~1, and B₂ around ~12 (mBERT-B₂) and ~6 (XLM-B₂); IE-Slavic shows mBERT-L₂ around ~11 and XLM-L₂ around ~9, R₂ near ~1 or slightly below, and B₂ around ~17 (mBERT-B₂) and ~16 (XLM-B₂); IE-other shows L₂ around ~6 for both models, R₂ near 0 to slightly negative, and B₂ around ~8 for both; Isolate shows values clustered near ~0–2 across all six bars; Semitic shows mBERT-L₂ around ~11 and XLM-L₂ around ~16, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ slightly negative (around −2 to −1), and B₂ around ~15 (mBERT-B₂) and ~19 (XLM-B₂), with notably large error bars on several Semitic bars; Uralic shows very small effects near ~0–2 for all bars. The bars are not visually sorted by height; they are grouped by family with consistent within-group ordering by model/condition as indicated by the legend, and no bars appear specially highlighted beyond the color coding and error bars.
